Description
1 oz Pamp Suisse Gold Bar Lady Fortuna is manufactured by the bullion brand –
PAMP Suisse
which is recognized around the globe for its innovative designs, state-of-the-art facilities, and industry-leading efforts to curtail
precious metal counterfeiting
.
PAMP Suisse, a prominent swiss refinery was founded in Ticino in 1977. It quickly rose to prominence due to its outstanding craftsmanship. Investors and Collectors around the glove love the PAMP bullion brand. It Produces high-quality bullion bars and uses the most recent technologies to prevent bullion counterfeiting, Lady Fortuna is one of the most well-known series of the mint. This gold bar features the Veriscan Technology, a special microscopic topography that registers the bar in the PAMP Suisse Database.
PAMP Suisse’s Veriscan Technology uses metal microscopic topography to identify any registered products. This helps in detecting counterfeits. The Veriscan, which authenticates each bar after it is produced, scans each bar when it is received by the customer.
The 1 oz PAMP Suisse Gold bar contains 1 troy oz of gold of purity .9999 and comes with its original tamper-evident assay card which authenticates the weight and purity of the gold. The weight and purity of these gold bars are backed by the PAMP Suisse.
The assaying services of the bullion brand PAMP Sussie are world-famous likewise, it is among the world’s premier private mints which are manufacturing such amazing gold bars and ingots. This is why the gold investors and collectors have trust in precious metal items such as
gold
and silver from PAMP Suisse.
Design of 1 oz PAMP Suisse Gold Bar – Lady Fortuna
The 1 oz Gold PAMP Suisse Fortuna Veriscan Bar is adorned with the well-known Roman Goddess of Fortuna and luck i.e Lady Fortuna. The Roman goddess is depicted holding her traditional horn, overflowing with gold coins. Her sheaves of wheat signify prosperity and her poppies are for remembrance. The Wheel of Fortuna is hidden behind her figure. Fortuna is depicted blindfolded to symbolize her inner knowledge of the world’s ways.
The reverse design of the 1 oz PAMP Suisse Gold Bar – Lady Fortuna features the PAMP Suisse logo which includes the words “PAMP” enclosed inside a four small circle followed by the term “Suisse” just underneath it. The “ESSAYEUR FONDEUR” stamp is essentially a “maker’s mark ” that all the prestigious swiss refineries use on their brand-name products. The other labels arranged in a vertical way on the reverse side are the weight, purity, metal content, and a unique serial number at the .bottom
Main Highlights of PAMP Suisse 1 oz Gold Bar – Lady Fortuna
Contains 1 troy oz of .9999 fine gold.
Weight and Purity backed by the PAMP Suisse.
Mint uses a thin, plastic sheeting to protect your assay card when it is shipped.
Eligible to Precious Metal IRAs.
Contains the latest Veriscan technology, which uses the metal’s microscopic topography, similar to a fingerprint, to verify any registered product. The mint’s special bullion catalogue then registers this one form of a fingerprint. It can be accessed anytime when the bar is scanned to confirm its authenticity.
Features the Lady Fortuna’s popular design, the Roman Goddess of luck and fortune on the obverse.
Features the weight, purity, and assayers marks along with the unique serial number on the reverse.
Features its own unique serial number
